verified_by_code_review: Owned immutable Encoded byte array is cloned at construction and copyout; exact SHA identifies original coded source consumed by decoder; Annex-B prefix normalization and CSD split are explicitly documented.

Role contract requires actual SPS Main10/profile2, 4:2:0, both depths10, primaries9, matrix9, full range, transfer1 for base or8 for numerical map. Hardware/role/P010 advertised selection cannot substitute 8bit.
Actual decoder output must be P010 Image with crop/dimensions/color/PTS checks; copies complete before Image and output slot release; it never returns pre-encode source pixels.
Decode crop adds even crop origin relative to each plane current buffer position; row/pixel stride and last-sample bounds are validated, including corrected long cropY arithmetic.
Input/output Image ownership, output slot release and codec stop/release use finally/try-with-resources; cleanup errors are retained rather than swallowed.

Dequeue loops and copy entry/rows observe interruption; elapsed deadline checked in codec loop and after copy. Synchronous platform calls and finite copy work can overrun a wall-clock deadline; no hard cancellation claim.
AOSP MediaCodec MediaImage exposes 3 P010 plane views with chroma offsets2 and stride4; applies x/y plane origin and offsets cropRect consistently. Module does not add hidden offsets.

limits: No actual Android MediaCodec has executed. Phone encoder/decoder P010/Main10/color capabilities and lifetimes remain device validation requirements.
SPS/parameter proof is a bounded parser, not HEVC entropy validation; actual MediaCodec decode remains necessary.
This module does not convert RGB, create HEIF/gainmap metadata, integrate the ULike recorder or certify complete style/HDR preservation.
32MP per-frame and64MiB compressed bounds do not establish total phone heap feasibility.
Imported capture/processing IDs are assertions; digest binds coded bytes, not external capture truth.
HEVC4:2:0 VBR is lossy; 10bit does not mean lossless or exact1024values through compression.
